ns2:course.label: Public Goods Theory
ns2:course.description: In-depth analysis of the theory of public goods; includes public goods and externality theory, public choice, theory of cost-benefit analysis, optimal income redistribution, and fiscal federalism. Prerequisite: ECON 302 or equivalent. MSPE Graduate Student Standing.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Prerequisite: ECON 302 or equivalent. MSPE Graduate Student Standing.
